subject: Request: minimal SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review
messages:
From: Tom Liao <tom.liao@medsecure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Ng <claire@thirdpartyaudit.com>, Procurement <procurement@medsecure.com>
Date: 2025-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: minimal SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick engagement last week. Our procurement and security teams are doing a light vendor review and have asked for a compact evidence bundle to move the pilot forward. To keep this scoped small, could you provide a minimal set of artifacts covering the following points: 

- Current subprocessor roster (CSV) with hosting region/residency flags
- KMS/residency map for keys that may touch customer data (high level)
- CAIQ or SIG answers—we can accept a SIG-Lite/summary of control areas if available
- SOC 2 report excerpt (covering logging/backup/availability) or confirmation of SOC 2 status
- Telemetry/retention statement (what is retained, for how long, and who has access)

We'd like to get this by EOD 2025-08-05 so procurement can finalize the SOW. If there's a standard "minimal evidence kit" you prefer to send, that works too.

I attached our internal checklist to show what they expect (evidence_checklist.pdf). If you need to redact anything, please note that in the response.

Appreciate it —
Tom
Tom Liao
Sr. Security Manager, MedSecure Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@medsecure.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-29T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: minimal SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Tom — thanks, got it.

Soojin / Marissa — forwarding Tom's checklist. Can you assemble a compact evidence bundle scoped to MedSecure's asks? Prefer to provide a short set they can ingest quickly: CSV roster, high-level KMS residency map, SIG-Lite answers, SOC 2 excerpt, and a brief telemetry note.

Specific asks from me:
- Redact exact IP addresses but include regions (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1) on the roster
- For KMS, provide ownership + residency (Redwood-managed vs. customer-managed / region) not key material
- SIG-Lite: focus on control families they care about (Data Protection, Access Control, Monitoring) — one-paragraph answers each
- SOC 2: send excerpt PDF (overview + logging/backup sections) and link to full report if allowed under NDA

Deadline: target 2025-08-04 internal so we can route to legal if needed. Marissa, any concerns on sharing SOC2 excerpt?

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: minimal SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Kimberly — thanks for the ping. I can put together the minimal kit. Plan and items I'm attaching: 

1) subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (redacted IPs, includes region/residency + third-party role) — attached
2) kms_residency_map.pdf (high-level ownership/residency per service, no key material) — attached
3) sig-lite-answers.docx (one-paragraph answers for Data Protection, Access Control, Monitoring) — attached
4) soc2-excerpt.pdf (executive summary + logging/backup sections) — attached; full report access requires signed NDA per standard practice
5) short telemetry statement in the body below

Telemetry / retention summary:
- Operational telemetry (service logs, request/response traces): retained for 90 days in production telemetry; 365 days for aggregated usage metrics used by billing and performance dashboards.
- Access: engineering on-call and SRE with role-based access via IAM; account-level audit logs available to customers on request for dedicated/private deployments per their SLA.
- Redaction: no PII is stored in request traces; any customer-sensitive fields are masked at ingestion by our runtime.

Clarifying question: Do they need CAIQ full mapping, or will the SIG-Lite answers suffice? If they later request a full CAIQ we can provide a completed spreadsheet under NDA.

I'll assemble the Drive folder and share the link to MedSecure once Marissa confirms SOC2 excerpt shareability.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@medsecure.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medsecure.com>, Claire Ng <claire@thirdpartyaudit.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minimal SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Tom / team — thanks for the checklist. Please find our compact evidence bundle below and a short summary of items included. If you need anything redacted differently, let us know.

Included (attachments + Drive link):
- subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (redacted IPs; includes hosting region and "residency" flag) — attached
- kms_residency_map.pdf (ownership/residency only) — attached
- sig-lite-answers.docx (SIG-Lite Q&A focused on Data Protection, Access Control, Monitoring) — attached
- soc2-excerpt.pdf (SOC 2 Type II — executive summary and sections on logging/backup) — attached; full report available on NDA
- Telemetry statement (see below) and confirmation that no PII is stored in request traces

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GvX-evidence-bundle-medsecure

Telemetry statement (short):
- Service logs and traces: default retention 90 days; aggregated billing/perf metrics retained up to 365 days.
- Access: role-based IAM for SRE/On-call; audit logs retained and exportable on request for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Masking: runtime masks user-sensitive fields per our ingestion rules; engineering access is audited.

If this is sufficient for procurement, great — otherwise flag any missing pieces and we can escalate (legal for SOC2 sharing or redaction).

Next steps I propose: once you confirm sufficiency, procurement can proceed with SOW and we will record the approval in our vendor GRC tracker.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (attachment), kms_residency_map.pdf (attachment), sig-lite-answers.docx (attachment), soc2-excerpt.pdf (attachment)
